Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3088-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

Repeat.
803-4929-5365-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Cryptic Trilobite for additional mana.

The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Orzhov Basilica trigger.

 When Necrotic Ooze dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.

797-1164-2025-4398-4856.description:
Cast Mind's Desire for {4}{U}{U}.
Eye of the Storm and Mind's Desire each trigger.
Resolve the Mind's Desire trigger, copying it zero times.
Resolve the Eye of the Storm trigger, exiling Mind's Desire, copying Mind's Desire and Stolen Identity, and casting the Mind's Desire copy then the Stolen Identity copy, targeting Mirror of Fate, without paying their mana costs.
The Mind's Desire copy triggers, creating an additional Mind's Desire copy for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve those copies, exiling random cards from your library that you may play this turn.
Resolve the Stolen Identity copy, creating a token copy of Mirror of Fate.
Activate any Mirror of Fate by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling all cards from your library and putting Stolen Identity from exile on top of your library.
Resolve the remaining Mind's Desire copy, exiling Stolen Identity from your library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Cast Stolen Identity from exile without paying its mana cost, choosing any target.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling Stolen Identity, copying Mind's Desire and Stolen Identity, and casting the Mind's Desire copy then the Stolen Identity copy, targeting Mirror of Fate, without paying their mana costs.
The Mind's Desire copy triggers, creating an additional Mind's Desire copy for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve these copies, failing to exile anything from your empty library.
Resolve the Stolen Identity copy, creating a token copy of Mirror of Fate.
Repeat from step 8.
Once you have infinite storm count, repeat the loop but put Brain Freeze on top of your library with a Mirror of Fate activation in step 8.
Once Mind's Desire has exiled Brain Freeze, cast Brain Freeze from exile without paying its mana cost.
Brain Freeze and Eye of the Strom each trigger.
Resolve Brain Freeze's trigger, creating any number of copies of itself targeting any number of players.
